div.head: III Eg 8.1
div.ab: ⁊ gemet, swylce man on Wintancestre healde.
⁊ gange án gemet ⁊ án gewihte, swylce mon on Lundenbyrig ⁊ on Wintanceastre healde.
⁊ gange an gemet ⁊ án gewihte, swylce mon on Lundenbyrig ⁊ on Wintanceastre healde.
et mensura, sicut apud Wincestram habetur.
⁊ gange án gemet ⁊ an gewihte, swilce man on Lundenbirig ⁊ on Wintaceastre healde.
And gange an gemet and an gewihte swylce man on Lundenbyrig and on Wintanceastre healde.
And there shall be one system of measurement, and one standard of weights such as is in use in London and in Winchester.
And there is to be one standard of weights and one standard of measures, just as is used in London and Winchester.
and the system of measurement, as is observed in Winchester.
und (es gehe Ein A D G2) Maass (und Ein Gewicht A D G2), solches wie (in London und A D G2) in Winchester gehalten wird.
and (let there be one, A D G2) measure (and one weight, A D G2), such as is kept (in London and, A D G2) in Winchester.
div.note: Quadripartitus supports the text as above, but the Wulfstan MSS expand to: “And one standard of measurement and one standard of weight is to be current, as is observed in London and in Winchester.”
G1 reads And gemet, swylce man on Wintancestre healde.
